'''Law and crime'''
*[[Trafficking of Chinese nationals to scam centers abroad]], [[Human trafficking in Madagascar]]
**[[Madagascar]]'s [[justice ministry]] announces dismantling 13 Chinese-run [[scam center]]s since August, linked to 148 [[Chinese people in Madagascar|Chinese nationals]] who had previously operated [[scam centers in Cambodia]], and who might have been involved in [[human trafficking|trafficking]] Africans to commit fraud. The 148 Chinese are [[extradited]] to China. [https://www.afp.com/en/scam-centres-relocated-cambodia-operate-madagascar (AFP)]
*[[Gaza war protests in the United Kingdom]]
**[[Metropolitan Police|Police]] arrest 139 people outside the [[Embassy of the United States, London|United States embassy]] in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], during a protest supporting [[Palestine Action]], which the UK banned as a [[Terrorism in the United Kingdom|terrorist]] organisation in 2025. Police say most arrests involve support for a [[proscribed organisation]]. [https://apnews.com/article/uk-palestine-action-us-embassy-protest-arrests-181ab108a671bcabf5433863608949bc (AP)]
*A pregnant woman is shot dead and six others are injured in a [[Spirit Halloween]] store in [[Fairfield]], [[California]], [[United States]]. Another person is shot and killed in another Spirit Halloween store near [[Detroit]], [[Michigan]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/manhunt-california-spirit-halloween-shooting-dead-injured-police-rcna606673 (NBC News)]
